metadata.description: Vu Ha's Claude Code mods, skills, hooks and commands

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that breaks the context window down by category, like /context

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: A pane listing your project, user and plugin subagents, each with a run button

plugins.name: mr-panel
plugins.description: A pane listing your open GitLab merge requests and the ones waiting for your review

plugins.name: branch-bar
plugins.description: VS Code style branch row above the prompt: click the branch to switch (with filter, remote branches, create new), click sync to pull

plugins.name: changes-panel
plugins.description: A pane with the repo's uncommitted changes and their diff, plus Review and Commit + push buttons

plugins.name: steps-panel
plugins.description: Claude keeps its plan as steps (pending, in progress, done); a row above the prompt shows progress and a pane lists every step

plugins.name: restart
plugins.description: /restart quits Claude Code and reopens this same session in the same terminal, with permissions bypassed

plugins.name: jira-band
plugins.description: A row above the prompt showing the Jira ticket named in the current git branch

plugins.name: cost-guard
plugins.description: Session cost and rate-limit usage on the status line, with a toast when a threshold is crossed

plugins.name: turn-timer
plugins.description: Live turn time and tool-call count on the status line, with a toast after a long turn

plugins.name: vuha-toolkit
plugins.description: Agents (jira-ops, lib-consumer-impact, miniapp-web), skills (standup, release-notes) and hooks (lint on edit in prod projects, macOS notification when a long turn ends)
